corrections.reason: The printed text reads 'ሀሎ አሐዱ' (there was a certain...); Stage 1 erroneously inserted an extra 'አ' after 'ሀሎ'.
Both visually on the page and in canonical Ge'ez (Luke 18:4), the verb 'he thought' is spelled with ሐ ('ሐለየ'), not ሀ.
The Ge'ez noun for 'widow' (Luke 18:5) is printed with ዕ ('ዕቤር'), matching line 14 ('ዕቤርት').
The printed Ge'ez text (Luke 18:10) reads 'ክልኤቱ ዕደው' (two men); there is no 'አ' after 'ክልኤቱ'.
The traditional Andemta gloss for 'ፈሪሳዊ' (Pharisee / separated one) is 'እሉል ባሕታዊ', and the initial glyph on the page is 6th-order 'እ', not 'ኡ'.
There is a clearly printed '።' (አራት ነጥብ) at the end of the line after 'ብእሲ'.
In Luke 18:12 the Pharisee speaks in the 1st person singular ('አሥራተ እዴየ' - the tithe of my hand/possession), and the glyph on the page is 'የ' followed by word-divider dots, not 'ሁ'.
The Amharic translation of tithe ('አሥራተ') is 'ካሥር አንድ' (one out of ten, ከ+አሥር), and the glyph has the 4th-order shortened right leg of 'ካ' rather than 1st-order 'ከ'.
